x: In the 880 Yards John Brown, off 68, won in 1m. 56s., with Main third, Blunden fourth, and Bishop sixth. In the Two Miles Team we turned out three teams, but Finchley had the measure of us, finishing 1.3 and 4 to win by 7 points (3 to score).

Stan Blunden ran well to win the 220 Yards, and our representatives for the 440 were Alf Shaw and Les Cohen! George Powell had a field day in winning three field events, while young Hendry showed the results of Charlie Jones' careful coaching in clearing his highest jump of the season.
Charlie Jones took second place in the High Jump, with 4ft. 7in., and did 19ft. in the Long Jump, Blunden recording 18ft. 6¾in. Thompson took the Shot with 35ft., with Powell third, 27ft. 5½in.
Thanks to some good last lap running by Blunden, Charlton and Stan Davies we eventually ran out winners of the "Dewar" Shield with a total of 141 points, with South London 145 and Herne Hill 177.
